newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan June vehicle output up 16.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan June vehicle output up 16.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's domestic vehicle production rose 16.1 percent in June from a year earlier to 977,625 vehicles, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association said on Thursday.
Japan's vehicle output in the first six months of calendar 1997 totalled 5,698,825 vehicles, up 12.1 percent from a year earlier.
Japan's domestic vehicle production rose in June for the fourth straight month on a year-on-year basis.
In the January-June period of 1996, domestic vehicle production fell 4.3 percent from the previous year.
The association said it expected Japan's exports to have risen about 32 percent in June from a year earlier and exports in the January to June period to have risen about 21 percent.
It will announce official export figures on July 28.
